verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack names GGUF. The only support is indirect community evidence: Ollama runs on a llama.cpp backend, a user ran a q4_K_M-quantized model (a llama.cpp/GGUF quant type) via 'ollama run', and models can be pulled from Hugging Face with 'ollama pull'. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of GGUF support, a documented workflow for importing local GGUF files (e.g., a Modelfile FROM path), and hands-on confirmation of loading arbitrary GGUF files.
